newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight sees light fresh enquiry.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight sees light fresh enquiry.

text.p: The sugar freight market was still rather subdued after the Easter holiday period with brokers reporting just a few fresh orders.
Commodity Specialists required about 12,500 bulk from Point Lisas to US Gulf or Atlantic and the same charterers still have 20/22,000 bulk open from La Romana to Crockett for mid-April.
ED and F Man wanted 7,000 bagged N.Spain to Syria prompt and Dreyfus 12,000 bulk Thailand to Japan for mid-April and 3,000 bagged from Puerto Quetzal to Chile for mid-April.
